title: How Myst Almost Couldn't Run on CD-ROM | War Stories | Ars Technica
summary: Myst co-creator Rand Miller recounts how the HyperCard-built game struggled to run on 1x CD-ROM drives. He and his brother Robyn compressed image and audio data heavily to get acceptable performance. Part of Ars Technica's War Stories series.
why: HN commenters point to it as the first-person story of how Myst grew out of HyperCard and fit on CD-ROM, especially in threads about HyperCard and retro game constraints.

quote.text: is actually more fascinating and entertaining in my opinion.
